## 1. Record browser-local usefulness judgment on mining reports

A minimal browser-local usefulness signal on a mining report so Remi's review can be recorded and compared across runs

**Why now:** The factory's current learning question cannot be answered without owner judgment, and today that judgment has nowhere to go: reports render evidence and drafts but capture no useful/not-useful signal, while the backlog is empty (0 issues/0 PRs) so mining quality is the only near-term factory metric.

**Evidence**
- factory/context/goal.md:17 near-term question is whether a fresh agent suggests work Remi would seriously consider
- docs/verification.md:24 hosted-report proposals for usefulness feedback remain for Remi review; stale-doc item already fixed
- factory/context/project-map.md:17 no task-mining quality evaluation in the deployed app
- apps/factory/app/components/MiningRun.vue:72-77 findings render + draft handoff with no usefulness control; MiningStation.vue:46-54 browser-local history only
- default.bash pnpm test exit 0 (16 factory tests pass) so the station baseline is green; the gap is judgment capture, not build breakage
- GitHub issues: 0 items complete + pulls: 0 items complete captured 2026-09-12T11:40:34Z, so there is no existing backlog signal to substitute for owner judgment

**Existing work:** Builds on the delivered native Eve station (apps/factory/agent + MiningRun/MiningStation) and the completed calibration/replay work described in factory/context/work-in-progress.md:5-13. Does not rebuild the fx wrapper (explicitly forbidden by work-in-progress.md:17) and does not claim the withheld factory/mining/ scores. Prior hosted run correctly distinguished completion from usefulness/acceptance; this task adds the missing acceptance-capture affordance.

**Scope**
- Add one small UI affordance in MiningRun.vue (or its utils) to record useful/not-useful + reason for the displayed report
- Carry that annotation into the existing browser-local draft via the draft() emitter, or document why it is kept separate
- Update docs/cockpit.md review-together checklist in one paragraph; no backend, no scheduled mining, no shared indexing

**Acceptance criteria**
- A reviewer can mark a completed mining report as useful / not-useful (or equivalent scale) plus an optional short reason entirely in the browser, without implying shared storage, publication, or automatic rule change.
- The judgment travels with 'Use findings in a draft' provenance (session id, revision, capturedAt) or is explicitly excluded by design with a stated reason.
- Incomplete findings remain visibly incomplete; a usefulness mark never clears a context-gap warning.
- No new server persistence, auth model, or evaluation-score display is introduced unless explicitly scoped and reviewed.

**Uncertainties**
- Whether Remi wants even browser-local persistence or prefers an external review note; keep it removable
- Whether a binary mark plus reason is enough or a held-out rubric comparison is still required — do not import factory/mining/ answers to decide this
- Vercel deployment evidence for this change could not be checked here due to the auth gap above

## 2. Define the bounded Jira demo slice before any Jira build

A bounded ADEO Jira demo-scope note that lets future mining reject out-of-scope Jira sprawl with a citation

**Why now:** Without a cited scope, every mining run can invent plausible Jira features that the goal explicitly says do not demonstrate factory progress; the empty backlog plus fixture-only Jira shell makes this the cheapest time to draw the boundary.

**Evidence**
- factory/context/goal.md:21 exact compatibility subset and identity behavior need concrete demo scenarios before implementation; feature parity is not evidence of an agreed spec
- packages/project-context/src/jira-reference.json:21-33 issueTypes + statusesForEachListedIssueType with limitations: not a transition graph, no permission/MCP/browser inspection
- apps/jira/app/app.vue:1-17 search/filter over demoIssues fixtures; :63-68 fixture notice states changes/accounts/APIs arrive later
- packages/project-context/src/index.ts:120-161 demoIssues ADEO-1..4 synthetic fixtures
- default.bash grep for feedback/rating shows no existing scope or usefulness gate in app or context code

**Existing work:** Follows the hosted-report proposal noted in docs/verification.md:24 (bounded demo scope, still pending Remi review) and the goal's factory-first constraint that shipping more Jira features alone is not factory progress. Complements but does not duplicate the completed calibration experiment or the active native Eve delivery.

**Scope**
- One doc (or project-context reference update) + a fixture-to-scope table only
- Review by Remi for product taste; no UI/API implementation, no auth work, no MCP work

**Acceptance criteria**
- A short reviewed doc names the demo slice: which issue/list/board/detail behaviors are in-scope fixtures vs explicitly out-of-scope (API mutation, accounts, SAML/directory, MCP, Connect writes)
- Each in-scope behavior maps to the observed source: packages/project-context/src/jira-reference.json statuses/types and apps/jira/app/app.vue current fixture
- Doc explicitly states the transition graph, permissions, and appearance items that were NOT observed and must not be inferred
- No Jira feature code is written under this task; it gates future Jira proposals

**Uncertainties**
- Remi's taste on which slice (issue list vs board vs details) demonstrates the factory best in 3-4 hours
- Whether the scope should live as a project-context reference vs a docs/ note — choose one and state why

## 3. Correct stale fx-runtime claim in factory README

Two-paragraph doc correction removing the stale fx-runtime claim

**Why now:** A fresh miner reading factory/README.md first will misdescribe the deployed station and propose rebuilding or re-verifying the fx wrapper, exactly the duplicated work the work-in-progress record forbids.

**Evidence**
- factory/README.md:5 'It uses the same AI SDK Harness/fx runtime as the calibration CLI' vs factory/context/goal.md:11 'There is no nested fx model loop' and factory/context/work-in-progress.md:17 'Do not propose rebuilding the fx wrapper'
- docs/cockpit.md:40 hosted station runs Eve directly, fx separate; factory/task-mining-station.md:9 native Eve 0.52.5 direct
- factory/reflections/2026-09-12-context-review.md:21-23 reconciling status with evidence prevents recycled fixes — same rationale applies here

**Existing work:** Continues the stale-doc reconciliation already done once in docs/verification.md:24 and the reflection hypothesis that explicit inventory + active-work record reduces false missing-work proposals. Tiny follow-up, not a new investigation surface.

**Scope**
- Edit factory/README.md:5 and optionally docs/factory-growth-experiment.md:25 only
- No code, no runner, no replay/transfer work

**Acceptance criteria**
- factory/README.md no longer claims the cockpit station uses the fx/AI SDK Harness runtime; it matches goal.md:11, work-in-progress.md:17, and task-mining-station.md:9-11 (native Eve direct, fx packaged separately)
- docs/factory-growth-experiment.md:25 shared-runtime sentence clarified or cited to the same native-vs-fx boundary
- pnpm test + typecheck still pass; no behavior change claimed beyond the doc fix

**Uncertainties**
- Whether the growth-experiment line means shared lessons vs shared code — phrase conditionally if ambiguous rather than asserting either

## Reflection

**helpfulContext**
- goal.md + work-in-progress.md + project-map.md together prevented three classic false proposals: rebuilding the runner, publishing the inventory, and starting replay/transfer work.
- .mining-snapshot.json explicit exclusions plus verification.md dated evidence made it possible to treat factory/mining/ and git history as unavailable-by-design rather than missing work.
- Live GitHub reads returning complete zero-item inventories plus passing pnpm test (exit 0) grounded the empty-backlog + green-baseline facts without overclaiming deployment state.

**missingContext**
- Vercel project/deployment/build-log evidence for both apps (blocked by user-scoped auth in sandbox).
- Git history / CI logs (excluded from snapshot; project-map names this as missing evidence when needed).
- Held-out mining prompts, rubrics, runs and scores (intentionally withheld to preserve independent judgment).
- External research sources cited in docs (local paths outside repo).

**contradictions**
- factory/README.md:5 says the cockpit uses the same AI SDK Harness/fx runtime, contradicting goal.md:11, work-in-progress.md:17, cockpit.md:40, and task-mining-station.md:9 which establish native Eve direct with fx packaged separately.
- docs/factory-growth-experiment.md:25 'asynchronous Eve station now uses that shared runtime' is ambiguous against the same native-vs-fx boundary and needs the same clarification.

**suggestedImprovements**
- Consider a one-line pointer in factory/README.md to work-in-progress.md for active-work checks, since empty GitHub lists still mislead without it.
- Consider documenting the expected Vercel-auth fallback behavior for sandbox mining so future runs file one standard gap string instead of re-diagnosing ConnectionAuthorizationFailedError.
- Keep the usefulness-feedback proposal browser-local until Remi explicitly requests shared indexing, to avoid prematurely deciding the scheduled/dedup design choices goal.md:23 leaves open.

## Context gaps

- Vercel evidence unavailable in this sandbox: both cockpit and jira vercel_read calls returned ConnectionAuthorizationFailedError (user-scoped connection fell back to local-dev access, no authenticated Vercel user/OIDC). Cannot distinguish deployed revision from working snapshot a7f5e27.
- Local Git history unavailable: `git log/status` returns `fatal: not a git repository`; commit/CI facts beyond docs/verification.md cannot be inspected. Per project-map.md this is an expected snapshot exclusion, not proof of no history.
- factory/mining/ prompt, rubric, raw runs and scores intentionally excluded from .mining-snapshot.json; judged as unavailable-by-design, not missing work.
- GitHub issue_comments inventory not collected: reader requires a positive integer issue number and the issues inventory is zero items, so there were no comment threads to fetch.
- Research sources cited in docs/cockpit.md and docs/factory-growth-experiment.md live outside the repo (/Users/remiconnesson/knowledge-work/...) and were not inspected; proposals depending on them would need a scoped excerpt.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for cockpit.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for Jira.
